name: Lewis Santer
bio: Lewis Santer is an actor known for Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey 2 (2024), Fairest of Them All (2025) and Devil's Heir: A Hollow Throne (2026).

credits.overview: Set in a bleak future in which the world suffocates under the iron fist of a tyrannical regime. Driven by unyielding determination, Ken Shiro sets out on a perilous mission to find the gate to Hell and save his daughter from the Inferno.

credits.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey 2
credits.overview: Five months following the murders, Christopher Robin struggles to maintain a regular life while dealing with PTSD. However, deep within the 100-Acre-Wood, a destructive rage grows as Pooh, Piglet, Owl, and Tigger find their home and their lives endangered after their existence is revealed.
